author: Minecraft
description:
The first Minecraft Monthly of the year is here (whoa, that rhymed)!

Prepare for a blast of cuteness, as Vu Bui kickstarts 2026 with baby mobs beyond what you could ever imagine – just look at the baby chicken! And we’ll reveal even more new ones! Vu's also teasing about a certain blue dog coming to Minecraft, and if you feel you crave even more Mounts of Madness, AND want to up your saddle game, we've got the perfect add-on for you!

Finally, there's a special surprise waiting, sitting on Vu's desk!

Let's go, 2026!

Here's what's coming:
00:00 – 00:19 – Intro time!
00:20 – 02:20 – Let’s meet our new baby mob versions!
02:21 – 02:31 – A small peek at the upcoming Bluey DLC!
02:34 – 02:54 – Celebrating our 18,000,000 subscribers!
02:55 – 03:25 – Check out these baby mob looks!
03:26 – 03:55 – Up your saddle with the FREE Dungeon Descent add-on!
03:56 – 04:09 – Even MORE baby mobs looks!
04:10 – 04:56 – What’s up with that thing on Vu’s desk?

Read more about baby mobs:
https://www.mi
title: A SPECIAL SURPRISE + MORE CUTENESS?! | MINECRAFT MONTHLY
